items.content: The harness protocol has no CapabilityKind enum; capabilities are plain string kinds. Broker-mediated kinds are declared in packages/orion-research-harness/src/orion_research_harness/broker.py: LLM_COMPLETE (line 96, content must be a string, optional model_id/response_id), WEB_SEARCH (line 134, items with non-empty content and source_uri, array domain_ids), VERIFY_EVIDENCE (line 192, boolean passed, certificate_ids array, passing requires a certificate). Local kinds are declared in packages/orion-research-harness/src/orion_research_harness/local_tools.py lines 13-20: FILE_READ, FILE_WRITE, FILE_LIST, SHELL, PYTHON.
